operations.title: Smith divisibility gives the minimal localization for a Betti adjoint
operations.statement: For U P_H V=diag(d_i) and B'=UQ^TP_G, reduced denominators e_ij=d_i/gcd(d_i,B'_ij) have lcm L. Integral adjunction exists iff L=1; localization works exactly after inverting the prime support of L.

operations.title: Pairing determinant overestimates adjoint localization
operations.outcome: The first has minimal denominator L=3; the second has L=1 despite the same pairing determinant.
operations.falsifier: This falsifies using determinant primes alone as the integral-adjoint obstruction.
